name: Titanium.UI.iOS.MenuPopup
summary:
A menu popup provides the ability to create custom tooltip options using the `items` property
covering the native `UIMenuController` class.

See also:

* [iOS Developer Library: UIMenuController](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uimenucontroller)

examples.title: Example using multiple `items` and a `click` event.

properties.name: items
properties.summary: The items of the menu popup.
properties.description:
The items will be shown as soon in the menu popup when the `show` method is called.
To hide them again, use the `hide` method in conjunction.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary:
Includes options how the menu popup should be hidden. Introduced in SDK 5.2.0.

Note that the default here is equivalent to passing in `{ animated: true }` (while typically the default for [AnimatedOptions](api:AnimatedOptions) is false)

methods.name: isVisible
methods.summary: Indicates whether the menu popup is currently visible.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Includes options how the menu popup should be shown. Note that the default is to be animated.

inlined.name: MenuPopupShowParams
inlined.summary: Dictionary of options for showing a menu popup with [Titanium.UI.iOS.MenuPopup.show](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.MenuPopup#show).
inlined.description:
The parameters used when showing a menu popup. Must include the `view` property to tell the menu popup
at which view it should be shown. Also set the `animated` property to `false` if you want to show the
menu popup without an animation.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Determines whether the menu popup should be opened or closed animated.

properties.name: arrowDirection
properties.summary: Indicates the arrow direction of the menu popup.
properties.description: Use this property to indicate the menu popups arrow to use.

properties.name: view
properties.summary: The view where the menu pop is shown at.

events.name: click
events.summary: Fired when the user clicks at one of the menu popup items.
events.description:
This event provides the properties `title` and `index` which relate to the name and position
of the clicked item inside the `items` property.

properties.name: index
properties.summary: The index of the clicked item.

properties.name: title
properties.summary: The title of the clicked item.
